begins: on a phone, their group’s Magnets already open; nobody told them anything about it

asked.prompt: Tell a friend how it went.

said.said: It's a magnet-poetry app where a group shares one sentence. The sentence started as "I can explain the ____". I added "raccoon", so it now reads "I can explain the raccoon." Anyone in the group can change it, and tapping a word takes it out.
I expected a word-magnet game. The screen said "Tap a word to add it" and that the group sees the sentence, so that's what I expected, and that's what happened.
It was simple and it did what it said. The word moved from the tray into the sentence. I only tapped once. I didn't try removing the word or adding more. I also never saw who is in the group.

asked.prompt: Was anything too much? Leave it empty if nothing was.
Was there a moment you almost left? Leave it empty if not.
